children: The U.S. House of Representatives advanced legislation to formally custody the government's bitcoin holdings, a regulatory milestone for the asset. The bill frames BTC as a sovereign-held asset and moves the question of federal bitcoin custody into formal legislative treatment.

Formal custody of government-held bitcoin would place the asset alongside other sovereign reserves, reinforcing the institutional adoption narrative that has grown around BTC. For investors, the development reads as incremental regulatory legitimization rather than a market-moving shift.

The bill remains short of enactment, so its practical effect depends on further legislative steps. Until passage, the advance signals direction in U.S. policy toward bitcoin rather than a completed change in how federal holdings are managed.

title: Bitcoin: House Advances Bill to Formally Custody Government BTC Holdings - By 27 Sep 2026
